text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... you see,
I was practicing for the live performance just now...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Still, it seems the speaker volume
was set incorrectly, you see~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hearing it up close made my ears and head ring like crazy...
It's taking a while to clear up~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Being big is a good thing, sure, but...
Ow-ow-ow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Akebono was plagued
by a headache from the roaring noise...
